mapper.sql: (SELECT i.image_id FROM image i WHERE i.auth_id = p.user_id AND i.image_type = 'PROFILE' ORDER BY i.image_id ASC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT cpi.image_id FROM community_post_image cpi WHERE cpi.post_id = p.post_id ORDER BY cpi.image_order ASC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_image cpi WHERE cpi.post_id = p.post_id)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blockeduser bu WHERE bu.blocked_user_id = p.user_id AND bu.user_id = #{userId})
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM community_report cr WHERE cr.target_type = 'POST' AND cr.target_id = p.post_id AND cr.reporter_user_id = #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post p WHERE p.series_id = #{seriesId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.series_id AS seriesId, s.title_kor AS seriesTitleKor, s.title_eng AS seriesTitleEng, s.title_rom AS seriesTitleRom, s.title_nat AS seriesTitleNat, p.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, AS profileImageId, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, p.is_spoiler AS isSpoiler, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount, CASE WHEN cpl.post_like_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isLiked, CASE WHEN bu.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isAuthorBlocked, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM community_post p JOIN user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN series s ON s.series_id = p.series_id LEFT JOIN community_post_like cpl ON cpl.post_id = p.post_id AND cpl.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN blockeduser bu ON bu.blocked_user_id = p.user_id AND bu.user_id = #{userId} WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT cpi.image_id FROM community_post_image cpi WHERE cpi.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY cpi.image_order ASC
SELECT post_id AS postId, series_id AS seriesId, user_id AS userId, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM community_post WHERE post_id = #{postId}
